topic.title: W01 Discussion: Icebreaker
topic.text:
Overview

  • Purpose: To help you to build relationships and feel comfortable as a student in this course. 
  • Task: Introduce yourself to your instructor and fellow classmates and respond to their introductions.

Initial Post

  1. Please write at least one substantive paragraph OR submit a one- or two-minute video to introduce yourself to your instructor and fellow classmates.  To begin, select Reply. Be sure that your paragraph/video includes the following:
    • Your name 
    • Your interests 
    • Your family information 

Response Posts

  1. After you have made a post introducing yourself, comment on two of your fellow students' posts.
    • Ask two genuine questions of interest.
    • Choose someone who has less than three comments already.
